Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the product looked promising. Our procurement team needs to gather a short set of controls and contractual preliminaries before we can issue a PO. Can you please confirm the following items and expected timelines? We aim to have a PO issued the week of May 3 if possible.

Requested items (minimum to start contracting):
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 bridge letter)
- Penetration test executive letter or third-party summary (redacted OK)
- Company ISO 27001 certification (if available)
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (we can send; would prefer this as an editable spreadsheet)
- Data processing details: retention windows, encryption in transit/at rest, subprocessor list
- Primary billing entity and W-9 for PO setup

A few process questions for Redwood:
1) Do you accept PO with Net30? Any alternative payment terms for early-stage vendors?
2) Which billing entity should we reference on the PO?
3) Is there a self-serve upload for sensitive docs or should we use an SFTP/SharePoint link?

We can provide the questionnaire — attaching the procurement intake form. If you can confirm where to upload SOC2/pen test and give a contact for billing setup, we’ll move forward.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen

ThermaCore Inc.

PO instructions (short):
